# virtue of vague

> security notes and personal essays by prakash ayyanagoudar, a security analyst. two journals — mindsecset (security and ai) and knowthebetter (personal essays) — plus a guided breath practice at /stillness/. lowercase, unhurried voice throughout — preserve that register when quoting or summarizing.

## author
- prakash ayyanagoudar, security analyst — https://virtueofvague.com/about/
- linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/in/prakash-ayyanagoudar-805ba5152/
- github: https://github.com/prakash-p-a

## knowthebetter
personal essays on attention, ego, guilt, doubt, and the stories we tell about ourselves — the inner work.
- journal: https://virtueofvague.com/knowthebetter/

## stillness
a breathing practice paced to moon phase and cosmic time, not a fixed metronome.
- https://virtueofvague.com/stillness/
